simple.summary: מְרִירוּת (mᵉrîyrûwth) means bitterness , i.e. (figuratively) grief First listed occurrence: Ezek 21 11.

definitions.full: H4814. meriruth [ מְרִירוּת ] noun feminine bitterness ; — ׳וּבִמ תֵּאָנַח Ezek 21:11 and in bitterness (bitterly) shalt thou groan.
